TC-12/S24.title: Layout against the p72 prototype, both modes
TC-12/S24.detail: Signed off 2026-10-14 under Quinn's TC-03/S25 rule (prototype comparison set aside). The AC 1 part (Important Points in the bottom box of the fullscreen editor) is judged in S01/S02/TC-10 S23: holds in both modes. Differences from p72 for a human look: p72's bottom box is a free-text 'Important points (manual)' box with Dictate and 'Kept exactly as you say it'; the app shows cards with '+ Add Point' (Dictate inside the new-point box). p72 also has an Important Points card list on the Pre-Round tab ('Manual list … the AI never fills or overwrites them'); the app has none on the tab in either mode. Layout changed since the sign-off: re-sign suggested.
